scope: Proposed acceleration of clinically eligible adults seeking masculinization; not all clinic services, minors, estrogen therapy or surgery.

judgments.label: Cost per supported earlier start
judgments.basis: Assumed nominal USD $1,000: three all-in clinical/lab/medication encounter bundles at $250 plus $250 navigation/coordination allocation including unsuccessful engagement. Neither unit price nor utilization is measured locally; no assumed reimbursement savings.

judgments.label: Three-month utility difference
judgments.basis: Nolan 2024 randomized secondary analysis: baseline-adjusted EQ-5D-5L difference 0.07, reported 95% CI −0.07 to 0.21; nonsignificant. UK tariff, short open-label trial. Positive scenario values are not confidence bounds. Preserve reported interval rather than reconstructing one from the inconsistent reported P value.

judgments.label: Wait avoided
judgments.basis: Central three months matches the external trial window; local wait and number of accelerated starts unknown. Credit no benefit beyond three months; not a lifetime treatment estimate.

judgments.label: Within-window benefit onset
judgments.basis: 50% assumes a linear ramp from zero to the measured month-three endpoint. Immediate full benefit in the favorable case is a stress assumption, not observed onset.

judgments.label: Local transfer retention
judgments.basis: 50% judgment for Australian-to-SF care setting and population differences; no local causal utility measurement.

judgments.label: Genuinely accelerated share
judgments.basis: 50% judgment for starts actually brought forward by the donor rather than existing insurance/funding or alternative access. Do not credit all scheduled appointments.

nullBoundary: No shortened wait, no additional financing or no utility benefit means no finite positive-benefit price. The utility interval includes harm. Signed utility sensitivity is supported by the model; nonpositive health results are not presented as a positive cost-effectiveness price.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: A priced adult-testosterone access tranche: current waits, accelerated starts, clinician/pharmacy capacity, reimbursement and restricted-gift allocation.

excluded: Additional depression/dysphoria credit already reflected in utility
